title: arnavkj1995/WEAVER
abstract:
WEAVER is an efficient, consistent and high-fidelity world model enabling state-of-the-art robot policy evaluation, improvement, and faster test-time planning.

# WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation Arnav Kumar Jain 1,2,* , Yilin Wu 3,* , Jesse Farebrother 1,4 , Gokul Swamy 3 , Andrea Bajcsy 3 [ ](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.13672) [ ](https://arnavkj1995.github.io/WEAVER/) [ ](https://x.com/arnavkj95/status/2066919523685380387?s=20) [ ](https://huggingface.co/arnavkj1995/WEAVER) [ ](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yilin-wu/droid_ood_data) [ ](LICENSE) --- We introduce WEAVER: a world model architecture that satisfies the three desiderata: (i) fidelity, (ii) consistency, and (iii) efficiency. WEAVER unlocks state-of-the-art performance across policy evaluation (ρ = 0.870 correlation with real-world success rate), policy improvement (real-world success rate improvement of 38% on top of the π0.5 robot foundation model), and test-time planning (real-world success rate improvement of 14% with a 5–10× speedup over prior WMs). ## 🛠️ Setup Create a Python 3.11 environment and install dependencies with `uv`. For optional logging and development dependencies: You can also run commands directly through `uv`: ## Model Checkpoints and Datasets Download all released checkpoints from [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/arnavkj1995/WEAVER): This downloads the `WEAVER`, `WEAVER-FT`, and `WEAVER-ReFlow` folders. Each folder contains `checkpoint.pt`, `config.yaml`, and `norm_stats_relabel.json`. The OOD evaluation dataset used in this work is available at [yilin-wu/droid_ood_data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/yilin-wu/droid_ood_data). >[!abstract] 一句话总结：提出 WEAVER，一种潜在流世界模型架构，通过设计满足保真度、一致性和效率三大要求的建模方式，支持策略评估、改进和测试时规划。


# 一、动机

> 现有世界模型在机器人操作中难以同时满足保真度（fidelity）、一致性（consistency）和效率（efficiency），限制了其在策略评估、改进和测试时规划中的应用。


# 二、方法

> 提出 WEAVER，一种潜在流世界模型架构，通过设计满足保真度、一致性和效率三大要求的建模方式，支持策略评估、改进和测试时规划。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 策略评估中与真实世界成功率的相关系数 ρ=0.870；在 π0.5 基础模型上策略改进带来 38% 的真实世界成功率提升；测试时规划实现 14% 的成功率提升，且相比先前世界模型快 5–10 倍。


# 四、对我的启发

> 与机器人操作课题直接相关，WEAVER 展示了世界模型在策略评估、改进和规划中的潜力，但其依赖大规模预训练和 DROID 数据，未来可探索更轻量化的部署和跨任务泛化。
